$comment: AniZen <-> Anikku provenance record. Read by scripts/anz-upstream.sh. See AGENTS.md for the workflow.

anizen.historyNote: The root commit is a squashed snapshot of the Anikku tree. A history rewrite (git filter-branch) left refs/original/* behind, so AniZen shares ZERO commits with Anikku and git cannot compute a merge base. All upstream merges must be base-corrected with --merge-base.

upstream.name: anikku
upstream.historyNote: Anikku rewrote/rebased its own master after 2025-04-19. The live master therefore does NOT descend from the content ancestor recorded below, and the fork network is unrelated (compare API returns 404 across networks).

base.forkTipNote: salmanbappi/anikku master tip, 2025-12-24. Equal to aa016c4c32 + 2 local commits (update-checker URL, @JvmStatic on SAnime/SEpisode.create).
base.note: aa016c4c32 is the last common content ancestor: it differs from the AniZen root snapshot by only 8 files. Use it as the 3-way merge base.

vsForkEraRef.note: Measured 2026-09-13 with base aa016c4c32. Substituting the AniZen root snapshot as base instead yields 6 conflicts (it also flags the 3 player-control files and anikku-tracker/SKILL.md), which is why the true upstream commit is recorded as the base.

vsLiveUpstream.note: Upper bound from tree-level overlap on a blobless mirror; a base-corrected 3-way merge auto-resolves non-overlapping edits, so the real conflict count is lower.

unmarkedBacklog.note: Bootstrap annotation backlog. New work must use // ANZ; the backlog is reported, not enforced.
